verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a cloud SaaS that stores digitized mail, so the axis applies. The evidence covers choosing one of 53 U.S. street addresses for receiving physical mail and unlimited cloud storage of scans. Neither is a documented choice of where digital data is stored, so the address selection is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
